headlines: Yemen parliamentary speaker urges Egypt to avoid involvement in war 【Yemen parliamentary speaker urges Egypt to avoid involvement in war】The speaker of Yemen’s parliament wrote to his Egyptian counterpart urging Cairo not to be drawn into a war he said contradicts Egypt’s values. He warned that Egyptian involvement would pose a serious threat to national security and internal stability, and urged Egypt to resist following Saudi government policy to avoid dragging the region into wider turmoil.

Musk admits 'somewhat off track' in political affairs 【Musk admits 'somewhat off track' in political affairs】Foreign media report Tesla CEO Elon Musk said he had "somewhat gone off track" in political affairs, spending about four months at the White House—longer than the one-to-two months he said government involvement should have taken—and that he should have returned sooner to focus on AI.

Iran FM Araghchi meets Turkey's Fidan in Baghdad to discuss Strait of Hormuz, regional tensions 【Iran FM Araghchi meets Turkey's Fidan in Baghdad to discuss Strait of Hormuz, regional tensions】Iranian foreign minister Araghchi met Turkish counterpart Hakan Fidan on Saturday in Baghdad during an OIC meeting to discuss developments in the Persian Gulf, the Strait of Hormuz and wider regional tensions. They discussed bilateral ties and the situations in Gaza and Yemen, both emphasized the importance of diplomatic de-escalation; Araghchi briefed Fidan on recent Persian Gulf/Hormuz developments and related diplomatic moves and urged OIC members to act to stop what he called Israeli genocide and to jointly address Islamophobia.
